headline: Mahanadi Coalfields Slips 2% in Muted Market Debut
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields made a muted market debut after an 8,981 crore rupee IPO, with its shares falling 2% following a 1.5-times subscription rate.
why: Initial public offerings of state-owned subsidiary firms test institutional investor demand and local stock market liquidity.

impacts.name: Mahanadi Coalfields
impacts.why: A 2% drop on market debut indicates subdued initial trading performance post-IPO.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A modest 1.5-times subscription rate during bidding led to a muted opening and a 2% price decline on listing.
